# StorieD tours

> This site hosts walking tours published with StorieD. Each tour is a fully narrated, self-guided walking tour that opens in the phone browser from a QR code. Free to walk, no app, no account.

## Example tours
- [Hereford](https://tours.storiedtours.co.uk/hereford)
- [Hammersmith](https://tours.storiedtours.co.uk/hammersmith)

## About StorieD
- What StorieD is, pricing and guides: https://storiedtours.co.uk/llms.txt
- Website: https://storiedtours.co.uk
